# Lab 27.5: BigQuery MCP Server & Gemini CLI

## What We Are Going to Do
Run the open-source MCP Toolbox for Databases with a BigQuery source, connect Gemini CLI to it, and let the AI tool explore and query BigQuery safely.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Download the toolbox.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/googleapis/genai-toolbox/releases/latest | grep tag_name | cut -d '"' -f 4)
curl -sL -o toolbox "https://storage.googleapis.com/genai-toolbox/$VERSION/linux/amd64/toolbox"
chmod +x toolbox
./toolbox --version</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Define tools.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; tools.yaml &lt;&lt;EOF
sources:
  bq:
    kind: bigquery
    project: $PROJECT_ID
tools:
  list_datasets:
    kind: bigquery-list-dataset-ids
    source: bq
    description: List datasets in the project.
  top_categories:
    kind: bigquery-sql
    source: bq
    description: Revenue by product category for a country.
    parameters:
      - name: country
        type: string
        description: Country name, for example India.
    statement: |
      SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.sale_price), 2) AS revenue
      FROM \`bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items\` i
      JOIN \`bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products\` p ON p.id = i.product_id
      JOIN \`bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users\` u ON u.id = i.user_id
      WHERE u.country = @country
      GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
EOF
./toolbox --tools-file tools.yaml --port 5000 &amp;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   A fixed SQL tool with parameters is safer than letting an AI write any SQL.

3. **[CLI] Connect Gemini CLI.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">mkdir -p ~/.gemini
cat &gt; ~/.gemini/settings.json &lt;&lt;'EOF'
{"mcpServers": {"bq-toolbox": {"httpUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:5000/mcp"}}}
EOF
gemini</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   In Gemini CLI, type `/mcp` to see the tools, then ask: *"Which product categories earn the most in Japan?"*

4. **[Console] Audit.** Every tool call is a BigQuery job, visible in **Personal history**.

5. **[CLI] Stop the toolbox.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">kill %1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| MCP | Standard way for AI tools to call BigQuery |
| Toolbox | Defines safe, parameterised tools |
| Client | Gemini CLI (or any MCP client) |
| Audit | Normal BigQuery jobs |
